synthesis.climate_context: Shared Melbourne-metro temperate climate — rain, mud and grit tracked into high-traffic entrances, foyers and washrooms; general Melbourne context, not a suburb-specific measured claim.
synthesis.building_stock: Prestigious, leafy inner-eastern suburb of grand historic residences; original generous subdivision blocks filled with fine Victorian and Edwardian houses and period villas; regarded as one of Melbourne's most exclusive suburbs. [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]

retail_centres: Camberwell Junction — designated a Principal Activity Centre in the Melbourne 2030 Metropolitan Strategy, where three roads and three tram routes converge [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]

Burke Road shopping strip, running roughly 600 m north from Camberwell Junction; long one of the busiest retail strips in suburban Melbourne [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]
Camberwell Fresh Food Market — indoor fresh food stalls, operating since 1929 [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]
Camberwell Sunday Market — approx 370 stallholders, run by the Rotary Club of Balwyn since 1976 in the car park near the Fresh Food Market [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]

Camberwell Junction Activity Centre, subject of the Council-adopted Camberwell Junction Structure and Place Plan covering 6 precincts [source: https://www.boroondara.vic.gov.au/your-council/news-and-media/boroondara-news/councils-response-state-governments-latest-plan-camberwell-junction-activity-centre]
office_or_business_precincts: Commercial uses in Camberwell are concentrated near the Burke Road precinct; the suburb has almost no industrial land [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]
Camberwell hosts a number of notable head offices, including Pacific Brands and Bakers Delight [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]
institutions: Epworth Camberwell — the former Cedar Court Rehabilitation Hospital in Camberwell, acquired by the Epworth HealthCare private hospital group [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Epworth_HealthCare]
Camberwell Primary School, Hartwell Primary School and St Dominic's Catholic Primary School [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]
Camberwell Town Hall (City of Boroondara civic building on Camberwell Road) [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]
Our Lady of Victories Basilica and around ten established churches across the suburb [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]
hospitality_strips: Burke Road, Camberwell — the main commercial strip from Camberwell railway station south to Camberwell Junction [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]
Camberwell Junction precinct, where the Rivoli Cinemas sit just to the west in adjoining Hawthorn East [source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Camberwell,_Victoria]
commercial_anchors.commercial_summary: Camberwell's business premises are overwhelmingly retail, hospitality and small-office rather than industrial — Wikipedia records that there is almost no industrial land in the suburb and that commercial uses cluster around the Burke Road precinct. The centre of gravity is Camberwell Junction, a designated Principal Activity Centre and the subject of a Council-adopted structure plan, with the Burke Road strip running about 600 m north of it plus the Camberwell Fresh Food Market and the weekly Sunday Market. Larger commercial tenants include the head offices of Pacific Brands and Bakers Delight, alongside Epworth Camberwell, Camberwell Town Hall and several primary and secondary schools.
